intro: Whitespace normalization removes formatting differences from imported text without changing its words or punctuation. It can make exact comparisons and logs easier to inspect.
task: Collapse Unicode whitespace while preserving case and punctuation.
requirements: Return a string with each run of Unicode whitespace replaced by one ASCII space and leading/trailing whitespace removed. Preserve every nonwhitespace character exactly.
Text inputs contain valid Unicode scalar characters and at most 10000 characters.
Return the documented Python output types and preserve all caller inputs. Raise ValueError for invalid inputs unless the task explicitly reports a record-level rejection.

hints.title: Trace one record
hints.body: Split without a separator to recognize whitespace runs.

hints.title: Handle the boundary
hints.body: Join tokens with a single space; punctuation belongs to the tokens.

explanation: Whitespace normalization removes formatting differences from imported text without changing its words or punctuation. It can make exact comparisons and logs easier to inspect.
Unicode whitespace includes more than ordinary spaces. The contract deliberately preserves case and punctuation, so it does not silently turn different answers into the same answer.
